amendment_note: Prospective natural-text extension of the v1.7 geometric spectrum. Reuses only the valid contiguous enwik8 and TinyStories v1.4 cells, then adds fresh contiguous WikiText-2 and CodeParrot byte-stream profiles and students. Frozen before inspecting either new corpus profile or corrected learning curve.

datasets.source: pinned TinyStories BPE stream decoded to UTF-8 bytes

data.decode: tokenizers ByteLevel decoder in deterministic 50000-id chunks; retain first 5500000 UTF-8 bytes
data.sequence_semantics: contiguous circular training reads with a fixed held-out tail; tokens are never permuted

sequence_semantics.cyclic_reuse: contiguous circular read; tokens are never permuted

profile.crossfit: alternating target positions; both directions averaged
profile.memory_strategy: evaluate additive pair priors in active-pair chunks; forbid q^3 materialization

geometry.radius: maximum causal lag of a support
geometry.degree1_uncertainty: for a selected pair (a,b), report endpoints assigning aggregate W1 to radius a or radius b; W2 has radius b

analysis.difficulty: median normalized curve area; higher means harder
analysis.primary: Spearman geometric complexity versus difficulty at the conservative radius endpoint
analysis.decision_rule: SUPPORTED if the minimum geometry rho across radius endpoints is at least raw-degree rho + 0.20; REFUTED if the maximum geometry rho is no greater than raw-degree rho; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE
analysis.inference: descriptive and prospective-directional only; with n=4, report exact permutation p and leave-one-out sensitivity but do not claim broad significance

exclusions.m8_image_cells: same pre-fix CorpusFamily reader; not valid sequence-locality evidence
exclusions.tabular: unordered features do not test spatial locality
